oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.singularObject: one target-bound structural embryo proof case
oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.fixedAt: after deterministic target selection and structural discovery, before blind source research
oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.selection: exactly one eligible target case and exactly one structurally defensible embryo are bound to the case
oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.ranking: existing deterministic structural discovery order only; no semantic, source, or expected-correspondence ranking
oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.completion: the same frozen embryo, blind payload, pre-reveal function-or-Null, and later revealed sense are evaluated as one case
oneEmbryoOperationalDefinition.noSecondAttempt: a Null, mismatch, or inaccessible source does not authorize a replacement target or embryo

targetPoolRule.poolPopulation: a future predeclared, reviewed candidate pool created from the existing target-sense authority policy
eligible: one reviewable target sense or explicitly unresolved sense state
source locator and authority status pinned before selection
not a prior target, prior reveal, prior control, or prior research word
not already used by an embryo-first proof or replication lane
excluded: unresolved or conflicting target sense when one sense is required
words used in prior research, control, baseline, or reveal artifacts
entries whose eligibility depends on embryo, source hit, translation, etymology, or expected function
targetPoolRule.normalization: NFC; trim; lowercase only for identity comparison; preserve source spelling and locator in the sealed selection record
targetPoolRule.deduplication: stable source-profile identifier plus normalized lexical form plus authoritative sense identifier

targetSelectionRule.selectionAuthority: deterministic ordering of opaque eligible candidate identifiers
targetSelectionRule.orderingKey: stable opaque candidate identifier assigned before structural discovery
targetSelectionRule.tieBreak: code-unit lexical order of the complete opaque identifier

targetSenseAuthority.authorityClass: reviewed target-sense authority already accepted by the project
targetSenseAuthority.binding: one source sense identifier is sealed before blind research and is not chosen after viewing an embryo or source result
targetSenseAuthority.polysemy: multiple senses remain separate candidates; one-sense proof requires one independently reviewable sense
targetSenseAuthority.conflict: conflicting or unresolved sense authority yields Null or procedural invalidity according to the sealed record
targetSenseAuthority.blindVisibility: target word, sense label, gloss, translation, and locator are reveal-only for the blind operator

structuralEmbryoRule.eligibility: structurally defensible hypothesis with existing claim-boundary fields and provenance
structuralEmbryoRule.selection: choose the deterministic minimum eligible result using the existing structural order; if no defensible result exists, record structural Null

blindPayloadRule.serialization: canonical UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, preserved array order, and one final LF in the persisted file
blindPayloadRule.fingerprint: SHA-256 of the exact persisted payload bytes

sourceSearchUniverse.authorityRequirement: traceable locator, source identity, acquisition date or revision, and fact/inference/hypothesis/unknown classification
sourceSearchUniverse.ordering: the exact source list and class order are sealed before discovery
sourceSearchUniverse.queryBoundary: queries may use only the frozen structural embryo or an explicitly authorized identity-preserving transform
sourceSearchUniverse.sourceAddition: no new source tradition after the first blind query
sourceSearchUniverse.duplicateHandling: deduplicate by stable source record identity while preserving source order and provenance

stopRule.stopAfter: all predeclared source traditions and bounded query stages have been attempted or explicitly recorded unavailable
stopRule.inaccessibleSource: record SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and continue only within the frozen universe

preRevealFunctionOrNullRule.object: the existing strict-blind pre-reveal function-candidate set or explicit Null freeze

required: all artifact hashes and byte lengths verified

correspondenceGate.comparison: sealed pre-reveal function-or-Null versus independently authorized revealed target sense
correspondenceGate.claimBoundary: correspondence result is bounded to this case and does not promote origin, cognacy, borrowing, universality, production authority, or a canonical meaning map

outcomeClasses.validProofRequires: all pre-reveal artifacts plus the post-reveal correspondence result and verified hash chain

requiredPreRevealArtifacts.downstreamReference: sealed target record hash; never passed to blind operator

hashChain.identity: exact persisted UTF-8 bytes plus byte length
hashChain.manifest: each required artifact is listed by stable artifactId, path, byte length, and SHA-256; the manifest itself is hash-pinned

hashMismatchBehavior: FAIL_CLOSED; do not regenerate, infer, or reconstruct bytes after reveal

neverUsed: orthographic or etymological inference for structural selection
